household_message.text: Car full for my trip, leaving early tomorrow.

message_to_household: I’ve noted that you want the car charged to 100%, but I need a specific ready-by time to plan it. What time tomorrow should it be ready?

questions.text: What time tomorrow must the car be ready? “Early” is too vague to schedule.

problems: the household gave no clear time for the car; ask when it must be ready
